stemMd: Six identical pumps empty a tank in 10 hours at constant rates. How long would four of these pumps take on the same full tank?
explanationMd: The job requires 6 times 10=60 pump-hours. Four pumps need 60/4=15 hours. Time is inversely proportional to the number of equal-rate pumps.

distractorRationale.b: This does not preserve total pump-hours.
distractorRationale.e: Fewer pumps cannot finish sooner at the same rate.
distractorRationale.c: This ignores the reduction in total pumping rate.
